description: KickStream is a purpose-built sports engagement platform that blends live match awareness, fan communication, and admin analytics into a polished, real-time web experience. It pairs a React/Vite frontend with a Node.js/Express backend, MongoDB persistence, secure JWT session cookies, and real-time channels powered by socket.io and Ably. The product delivers live chat, match tracking, guest support, admin monitoring, and email notifications in a modern, performance-minded package.

frontend.structure: src/ contains modular components, hooks, pages, and admin UI. Main entry is App.jsx. Admin and user dashboards are separated.
features: User authentication with session persistence (JWT in HTTP-only cookies)
WhatsApp-like chat widget with real-time updates
Notification system for both users and admins (real-time, badge, dropdown)
Admin dashboard with user management, analytics, and email queue
Analytics tracking via useAnalytics hook (page views, visits)
Modern UI/UX with Tailwind and custom styles

backend.structure: backend/ contains server.js, routes (auth, admin, session), models (User, Message, UserAnalytics, Conversation, Notification), middleware, and scripts.
features: RESTful API for authentication, chat, analytics, and admin actions
Socket.io for real-time notifications and chat
Ably integration for scalable real-time messaging
MongoDB for persistent storage (users, messages, analytics, notifications)
Secure session management with JWT in cookies

dataModels.User: Stores user credentials, profile, and admin flag.
dataModels.Message: Stores chat and contact messages, sender info, timestamps, and read status.
dataModels.UserAnalytics: Tracks per-user analytics: visits, page views, matches watched, plan type, country, IP, and visit history.
dataModels.Conversation: Groups chat messages by user and admin for persistent threaded chat.
dataModels.Notification: Stores notifications for admin and user, with read/unread status.

realTime.socket.io: Handles user/admin identification, targeted notifications, and chat events.
realTime.Ably: Used for scalable pub/sub messaging in chat.
realTime.Frontend Hooks: useUserNotifications and useAdminNotifications manage real-time updates and UI pop-outs.

analytics.tracking: useAnalytics hook sends page view and visit events to /api/admin/analytics/track endpoint.
analytics.adminDashboard: Displays total users, emails queued, click events, and per-user analytics. Data is fetched from /api/admin/stats and /api/admin/analytics/users.

authentication.method: JWT in HTTP-only cookies for secure session management.
authentication.sessionCheck: Frontend checks /api/session on mount to persist login.
authentication.admin: Separate admin login and dashboard, with isAdmin flag enforcement.

notifications.realTime: Socket.io emits targeted notifications to users and admins.
notifications.UI: Notification badges and dropdowns pop out in real time on new events.

email.sending: Nodemailer utility sends emails to admin and users for important events.

security.auth: All protected API routes require valid JWT in cookies.
security.CORS: Configured for credentials and secure cross-origin requests.

setup.env: Requires .env file with MongoDB URI, JWT secret, Ably API key, and email credentials.
setup.start: Run backend with npm start or npm run dev. Frontend with npm run dev from root.
setup.scripts: backend/scripts/createAdmin.js creates an initial admin user.

agentNotes.LLM: This project is a modern, real-time sports companion with a focus on match awareness, chat, and operational analytics. The current architecture balances responsive marketing content with a protected auth flow, admin observability, and real-time updates. For future work, extend guest support paths, enrich match event analytics, and refine mobile-first hero media performance.
